title: mail-parser types do not appear in mime-tree public API
description: mail-parser is a private implementation dependency. None of its types (Message, MessagePart, PartType, etc.) appear in any public signature or re-export. All public types (ParsedPart, ParsedMessage, TransferEncoding, ParsedHeader) are defined in this crate. A future contributor might suggest exposing mail-parser types directly to reduce boilerplate. That would be wrong: it would lock the public API to mail-parser's versioning cadence, making any mail-parser major-version bump a breaking change for downstream users. The current design lets the implementation dep be upgraded without touching semver.
